correctness.rationale: Independent coordinate replay: a geodesic follows a shortest cycle arc and switches layers exactly once if the endpoints differ in layer. On each eligible arc a switch index must lie strictly between the last blocker on the destination layer and the first blocker on the source layer; same-layer endpoints require a clear arc. Exhausting all 1024 and 4096 subsets with this predicate reproduces both feasibility and optimal-mask hashes, all four polynomials, the ten stated four-set templates, and the two alternating-column six-sets with precisely their twelve deletions as nonmaximal feasible five-sets. Heredity makes the one-vertex extension test exhaustive for maximality. Orbit enumeration matches one size-ten orbit and, for C6, two size-twelve and nine size-twenty-four orbits. Grouping sets by shared (k−1)-subsets identifies each move edge; bitset neighborhood expansion gives ten slide isolates and a connected 2-regular ten-vertex jump graph for C5; for C6 it gives 816 slide edges with eccentricities 6 and 7 (120 each) and 1842 jump edges with every eccentricity 5, both connected on 240 vertices. The independent scripts did not execute the frozen programs.
residual_risks: The exhaustive universe is the two labelled prisms, and only minimum inclusion-maximal configurations are vertices of the move graphs.
